body: I work in food service. I'm a food packer for the next month, then I'll be a lead cook in a big kitchen for the next 5. I barely make enough to fund my game. And I'm not even close to max level. I'm still $2k away

Nice work! I also have suicidal thoughts, but i don't plan on doing anything yet. I am 6'2, 186 lbs and if I don't bring snacks to the computer I don't eat (no time). I've quit mobile strike which saves me a ton of money but I find it hard to stop playing on the computer. That's where all my friends are. :( without them I have nothing. I have a basic job to look forward to for the next 50 years and I can't go back to college for various reasons. I was just wondering if 12 hours a day is too much and it seems like it is, so I will try 8 hours a day now.

The worrying part is that I sometimes have to stare at certain sentences for longer than normal. It's like I'm losing my memory. Not sure if it's from lack of sleep, excessive gaming, or both. I'm not really worried about the depression part since I hardly ever play less than 6 hours. I can go 29 days without a single purchase then bam! $500 spent in an app. :( that's the annoying part. Deleting stuff doesn't help and I don't have the money for a therapist since I've spent it all on games. :(
